ينحدر (form VII)
# يَنْحَدِرُ (yanḥadiru) /jan.ħa.di.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# يَنْحَدِرَ (yanḥadira) /jan.ħa.di.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# يَنْحَدِرْ (yanḥadir) /jan.ħa.dir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
